security_audit.summary: All 161 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown links, formatting, documented URLs, placeholder credentials, and intended authentication examples. No prompt injection or unauthorized secret collection was found. However, paid actions can incur unbounded, nonrefundable charges without an explicit confirmation requirement.

remediation.issue: Paid calls and credit top-ups lack mandatory confirmation and spending limits.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before paid actions, enforce per-task spending caps, and stop pagination or polling when the cap is reached.

content.user_title: Retrieve Public Instagram Data by API
content.value_statement: Instagram data collection can require Meta approval, browser automation, or separate scraping infrastructure. This skill provides paid, read-only REST and MCP access to public Instagram data.
actual_capabilities: Resolves public Instagram profiles by handle or numeric identifier.
Searches accounts and retrieves posts, reels, active stories, tagged posts, followers, and followings.
Fetches individual posts by shortcode and retrieves post comments.
Retrieves public feeds for hashtags, locations, and audio tracks.
Provides endpoint parameters, pagination guidance, REST examples, and MCP connection details.
limitations: Supports read-only access and cannot publish, edit, or manage Instagram accounts.
Cannot access private accounts or historical stories.
Requires prepaid credits or x402 payments, with a stated charge for each call.
Returns live upstream data without a guaranteed response schema, webhook delivery, or server-side CSV exports.

use_cases.title: Monitor Competitor Content
use_cases.description: Track public posts, reels, hashtags, and engagement signals for selected accounts.

use_cases.title: Build Instagram Data Pipelines
use_cases.description: Collect paginated public profile and content data for internal analysis and reporting.

use_cases.title: Discover Public Creators
use_cases.description: Search profiles and compare public follower, biography, content, and topic signals.

prompt_templates.title: Profile Lookup
prompt_templates.prompt: Look up the public Instagram profile for @{handle}. Summarize the biography, follower count, following count, and numeric user identifier.

prompt_templates.title: Recent Content Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve recent posts and reels for @{handle}. Identify recurring topics, formats, and engagement signals. State which fields are unavailable.

prompt_templates.title: Audience Collection Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a follower collection for @{handle} with at most {pages} pages. Describe pagination, deduplication, storage fields, cost controls, and privacy safeguards.

prompt_templates.title: Monitoring Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a polling workflow for hashtag #{hashtag} and location {location_id}. Include cursor handling, change detection, retries, budget limits, and compliance checks.

output_examples.input: Which endpoint retrieves active stories for a public profile?
output_examples.output: First resolve the handle to a numeric user identifier. Then request active stories for that identifier. Historical stories are not available.

output_examples.input: Plan a daily hashtag monitor with a fixed budget.
output: Set a daily request and spending limit.
Store seen post identifiers and the latest cursor.
Poll on schedule and stop when either limit is reached.

output_examples.input: I have an Instagram post link. Retrieve its public details.
output_examples.output: Extract the shortcode from the link, request the matching public post, and summarize available metadata without downloading media files.

best_practices: Confirm that target data is public and collection complies with platform terms, privacy rules, and local law.
Set request and spending limits before polling or pagination.
Keep Bearer keys in environment variables and redact them from prompts, logs, and outputs.
anti_patterns: Do not attempt to retrieve private content or bypass access controls.
Do not run unbounded follower exports, polling loops, or paid requests.
Do not assume response fields remain stable without checking current API output.

faq.question: Does this skill require an Instagram login?
faq.answer: No. It accesses public data through fetcher.sh and does not use Instagram session cookies.

faq.question: Can it access private profiles or posts?
faq.answer: No. The documented endpoints only return information that is publicly visible.

faq.question: How is access paid?
faq.answer: Use prepaid credits with a Bearer key or x402 payments in supported USDC networks.

faq.question: Can it publish or modify Instagram content?
faq.answer: No. Every documented endpoint is read-only.

faq.question: Does it support pagination?
faq.answer: Yes. Several endpoints accept cursor or page parameters, depending on the resource.

faq.question: Does it provide webhooks or scheduled monitoring?
faq.answer: No. Build scheduled polling externally, store seen identifiers, and enforce request and spending limits.
